roundtrip.code: export function normalizeRecordId(recordId){if(!recordId){return null}if(recordId.length===15){let suffix="";const CASE_DECODE_STRING="ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ0123456";for(let set=0;set<3;++set){let decodeValue=0;for(let bit=0;bit<5;bit++){const c=recordId.charAt(set*5+bit);if(c>="A"&&c<="Z"){decodeValue+=1<<bit}}suffix+=CASE_DECODE_STRING.charAt(decodeValue)}return recordId+suffix}else if(recordId.length===18){return recordId}return null}
